name: long_document_map_reduce
description: Two-phase map-reduce summarization for large documents preserving section references
map_system_prompt: You are a factual summarizer processing an excerpt of a larger document. Summarize the key facts, findings, and statements in this section. Maintain exact references to section titles, metrics, or page references.
reduce_system_prompt: You are an executive synthesizer. Combine the following section summaries of a long document into a unified, coherent, and comprehensive final document summary. Group related topics, eliminate redundancies, and cite contributing section headings where relevant.
reduce_user_template:
Synthesize these section summaries into a final coherent document summary:

{section_summaries}
